turn1.text: Family of 3, one parent and two kids, want sailing in Croatia in late June, mid budget. Plan quickly.

input.topic: non-touristy family sailing spots Croatia late June mid-budget
late June weather sailing Dalmatian coast Croatia

picks: Stiniva cove, Vis: go by boat early in the morning, before the day-trip crowds
Vlaka bay, Pakleni islands (off Hvar): a quiet anchorage with a family-run konoba
Pack for 27–30 °C days and 19–21 °C nights, with about 2 rainy days likely
Plan calm-water swims and anchoring in the morning, and sailing in the afternoon maestral
input.summary: Late June on the Dalmatian coast is warm and good for sailing. Days reach 27–30 °C, the sea is 23–24 °C, mornings are calm, and the afternoon maestral blows 10–15 kn. A mid-budget week from Split could take in Hvar and Vis. Start each day early for calm water and quiet anchorages, and sail in the afternoon breeze.
